notes.note: Traced Start files through Home/NewChatModal, the new-chat intent, ChatDock intake/staging and the first send. The receiving engine owns refusal; steer/queue remain text-only and busy drafts retain files. useSTT retains the departing composer owner and stops its listening provider. Checked phone trailing Stop and Agent route CSS. Corrected touch outline priority against index.css global important rule. Browser clipboard fixtures do not qualify Android IME image insertion; the design now says so and labels the older comparison images historical. Canonical browser verification is in progress; no native or provider qualification claimed.

ChatDock pendingGoalSend now stages Start files before the first send. Pane placement, region surfaces and background-task Stop remain owned by the same callers; the changed comment describes refusal rather than retaining a refused file. No placement claim changes.

Checked the start composer phone actions against StartComposer.css: attach, mic and overflow join Start with 44px targets. The important touch outline override suppresses only the inner field ring; the box retains its focus border. ChatDock comment changes do not affect responsive placement. Browser fixture evidence is separate from native-device proof.

ChatDock Start handoff stages files through the existing chat attachment APIs. Reviewed the pendingGoalSend staging and failure paths; no route, request schema or response contract changed. The latest comment correctly distinguishes refused files from staged files needing retry.

The changed ChatDock comment and pending first-send path alter client intake only. Attachment configuration and retention remain server-owned, with no default or key change. Agent route labels remain presentation only.

Traced busy attachment blocking and the text-only steer/queue callbacks. Files remain in the draft until the person sends after the turn ends; dictation changes draft text. Start handoff refuses unsupported files rather than sending the message without them. The corrected manual-send sentence matches the implementation.

Checked useSTT ownership/unmount handling and the example voiceRegistry consumer. The example does not call the app-internal hook; host provider selection and public SDK boundary remain unchanged. No transcription/provider runtime qualification performed.

Retained historical comparison image and its original captured revision/digest. This is the earlier composer redesign, not a current attach/mic reference. The design text now explicitly states that these historical comparisons predate the new start paperclip and mic. No recapture or current native/runtime claim is made.
